notes:
CRM notes / call log - focused on embeddings + reranking for product KB RAG (hosted API)

Summary:
- Aurum provides a SaaS knowledge-base add-on for B2B support teams. Looking to replace slow keyword search with dense retrieval + cross-encoder reranking to improve answer precision.
- Scope: moderate index (~1.2M canonical docs / ~2.4M embedding vectors after split), high QPS profile: steady 200-400 qps, peaks ~700-1000 qps during business hours.
- Targets: end-to-end p95 latency (retrieve + rerank + response) <= 200ms ideally, acceptable up to 300ms for complex queries. Cost target: <= $0.02/query average; high sensitivity to tokenized reranker cost.

Technical preferences / constraints:
- Prefer hosted API for speed of rollout. No on-prem requirement right now; must meet SOC2 and US data residency for customer subset. SSO (SAML) and audit logs mandatory.
- Ingestion cadence: near-real-time incremental updates from customers (webhooks + daily bulk sync). Expect 5-10k docs/day after go-live.
- Retrieval architecture they'd like to test: ANN index (vector store) for top-100 candidates -> cross-encoder rerank top-10. Concern: cross-encoder CPU/GPU cost at high QPS.
- Embedding dims planned: 1536; using open embeddings or Redwood-verified models. Want recommendations on quantization + batching to reduce cost.

POC plan discussed (agreed on call 2026-02-14):
- Week 0: ingest 200k sample docs (sanitized) and baseline current search (Elastic).
- Week 1: deploy hosted-api retrieval + bi-encoder embeddings, measure recall/latency.
- Week 2: enable cross-encoder rerank on top-10, evaluate relevance uplift vs cost. Provide per-query cost estimate.
- Metrics: R@10, mean reciprocal rank, p95 latency, cost/query.
